unsure: Design decision: this rejects source that 2.13.0-2.13.18 accept. Fixed because SLS 11/6.24 is explicit, 2.12.20 and Scala 3 (for Java annotations) reject the same arguments, and the forms are unlikely in real code; a deprecation warning for one release is the conservative alternative, named in the PR body. It also applies to Scala ConstantAnnotations (@deprecated, @nowarn, @SerialVersionUID), which Scala 3 does not check. The predicate relies on the OriginalTreeAttachment that adaptConstant leaves on folded literals and accepts a Select of any stable symbol regardless of its qualifier (needed for the existing impure-qualifier test), so K.four for a non-final val four: 4 is still accepted. The full run category was not rerun with the final, more permissive predicate. The error for a block prints the typed tree (with the val's accessor).
note: tryConst now also checks that the argument's original tree is a constant expression in the sense of SLS 6.24; blocks and calls of literal-typed methods are reported with the existing 'annotation argument needs to be a constant' error.
